title: Write Playwright E2E test: email sending
description: Write Playwright E2E test for the email sending flow. Tests that an outreach email can be sent (in mock mode) for a ready prospect.
acceptanceCriteria: E2E test file exists at tests/e2e/email.spec.ts
Test uses a ready prospect (generated or fixture)
Tests: email form renders, send button submits the email, success toast appears, sent email record appears in GET /api/email/sent
Tests pass with EMAIL_MODE=mock (no real emails sent)

steps.details: Navigate to /batches/[id] with a ready prospect. Find the 'Send Email' action for the prospect. Click it. Select template 'coldOutreach'. Confirm send. Assert success toast appears.
After sending, call GET /api/email/sent via page.request. Assert the response includes a record with the prospect's business name and mode='mock'.
Run `npm run test:e2e tests/e2e/email.spec.ts`. Tests pass. Verify mock email file created in public/mock-emails/.
